description.value: Agra Tandoori is an Indian tandoori restaurant in the Vancouver area, offering cuisine from the Indian subcontinent. The business operates with a TouchBistro point-of-sale system, indicating an established restaurant operation. Touring cyclists passing through the area would find it a potential stop for a substantial Indian meal.
